# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/config/gen`. Do not edit by hand. -->

PlayPresence reads one TOML file. Keys you omit keep their default value, and unknown keys are rejected.

| OS | Default location |
|---|---|
| Windows | `%AppData%\playpresence\config.toml` |
| Linux | `~/.config/playpresence/config.toml` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/playpresence/config.toml` |

Credentials (server tokens, optional API keys) are **never** stored in this file: they are kept in the OS credential store. A file containing a token or key field is refused.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `discord.app_id` | string | empty | Numeric ID of your own Discord application (Developer Portal). Optional: by default the application named after your media server is used, so its name shows after "Watching". |
| `presence.min_interval` | duration | `15s` | Minimum delay between Discord updates. Cannot be lower than 15s. |
| `presence.priority` | list of strings | empty | Source names, most important first, used when several sources play at once. Empty means alphabetical. |
| `art.resolvers` | list of strings | `server`, `plex`, `tvmaze`, `itunes`, `musicbrainz`, `openlibrary` | Artwork resolvers tried in order until one returns an image. Available: server, plex, tvmaze, itunes, musicbrainz, openlibrary, tmdb, fanart, declared_url, upload. |
| `sources.<name>.kind` | string | empty | Server type: jellyfin, plex or emby. |
| `sources.<name>.url` | string | empty | Base URL of the server, http or https. |
| `sources.<name>.user` | string | empty | Server user whose activity is shown. Empty means the account you signed in with; use "*" to show every session the token can see. |
| `sources.<name>.disabled` | boolean | `false` | Set to true to keep the entry but ignore it. |
